credits_text: A LATERNA VENTURE PRODUCTIONS PRESENTS A URSULA PRATT FILM FEATURING MUSIC BY MATTHEW JONES. WRITTEN AND DIRECTED BY GREER SIMMONS. STARRING RYAN FLOYD, XIANI LIU, ALICE RICHARDSON, JORDAN RICHARDSON, LAURIE GAGE AND FARMEN RICHARDSON. PRODUCED BY RYAN FLOYD. MUSICAL SCORE BY MATTHEW JONES. FIRST RELEASED IN 2016. FEATURING THE ORIGINAL SONGS "IN THE WATER'S FINE" AND "PLUNGED."
description: A dark green poster features a central silhouette against a large, stylized face with branches framing the edges. The title "GREEN LAKE" is prominently displayed in bold yellow text.
